svg.aria-label: Side view of the Touring's right rear quarter, drawn to scale from BMW drawings with the rear hub center as datum, and below it a top-view strip of how far the M3 skin stands out at each station along the car. The M3 flare stands about 21 to 23 mm proud of the Touring's skin from 300 mm ahead of the axle to 100 mm behind it, about 25 mm at 150 mm behind, 29 to 32 mm from 200 to 350 mm behind, then about 22, 13 and 10 mm at 400, 450 and 500 mm behind, and 7 mm at 600 mm behind. From about 150 to 220 mm behind the axle, below the bumper's top line at about 305 mm above the hub, the arch edge is the bumper cover, so the larger figures behind the axle are mostly the M3 bumper corner, not steel (inferred). The flare starts 380 to 420 mm ahead of the axle. The rear door meets the arch about 300 to 350 mm ahead of the axle and 150 to 250 mm above the hub, so the first part of the flare's ramp falls on the door, and with a stock door the M3 surface stands about 11 to 20 mm proud at the shut line: the M3 nose is beaten in over its last 60 to 100 mm. BMW's gap from rear door to side wall is 4 plus or minus 0.75 mm. The bulge's edge peaks about 475 mm above the hub over the axle, ends at the front about 315 mm ahead of the axle and 375 mm above the hub, and meets the bumper line about 300 mm behind the axle. The bulge blends in 470 to 530 mm above the hub, under the shoulder crease at about 540 mm; the arch edge is 340 to 350 mm above the hub at the top. Seam lines, our inference rather than a BMW procedure: top 500 to 515 mm above the hub; rear 550 to 600 mm behind the axle, down to about 250 mm above the hub behind the bumper; front 25 to 40 mm behind the shut line, parallel to it, down to the sill flange. The tail lamp starts about 700 mm behind the axle; the filler flap's position is approximate. Template stations: 400, 300 and 150 mm ahead, the axle, and 150, 300 and 450 mm behind. Figures are good to about 5 to 10 mm; confirm them with templates on both cars.
svg.text: Datum: the rear hub center. Sizes in mm, scaled from BMW drawings, ±5–10 mm: confirm with templates on both cars.
shut line; beat the nose in
Filler flap, right side: position approx. Where the top seam would
cross its surround, step the seam up round it.
M3 steel flare: over the axle
BMW has no arch section: it replaces a Touring's whole side wall (TIS 41 35 101). These seam lines are our inference from the drawings: move one where the
two cars' templates disagree by more than 1 mm. The door/arch junction (±50 mm) and the filler flap's position are estimates: measure them on the car.
The front seam's path round the arch is drawn generically.
